title: SpecPatch v1
description: A set of operations over the project spec, plus the text shown to the client for confirmation. Emitted at the human gate (spec.patched). Forward-compatible; operation shapes are open (op is a string, payload is free-form) so hosts can add operation kinds additively.

op.description: Operation kind. Open string; common values below.

target.description: What the operation applies to (story id, section ref, status key, ...).

confirmation_text.description: Human-language description of the change for client confirmation at the gate.
